Add contact sheet for substitute teachers

Substitutes need a quick list of each student's section and email. Missing emails and empty rosters raise an error naming the problem so the sheet is never silently incomplete.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students):
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name and lined up."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    name_width = max(len(student.display_name) for student in ordered)
    sect_width = max(len(student.section) for student in ordered)
    return [
        f"{student.display_name:<{name_width}}  {student.section:<{sect_width}}  {student.email}"
        for student in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([Student("2", "Zed", "Al", "B", "z@x.org"), Student("1", "Ames", "Bo", "A", "a@x.org")])
        self.assertEqual(rows, ["Ames, Bo  A  a@x.org", "Zed, Al   B  z@x.org"])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Ames, Bo"):
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Ames", "Bo", "A")])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
